verdict.rationale: Helicone is an LLM observability platform and gateway, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt file, markdown docs and OpenAPI spec are adjacent developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
